Birthday Limo Phoenix: Celebrate in Style

Whether it's a milestone birthday or just because, arriving in a limousine makes any celebration more memorable. Here's how to plan the perfect birthday limo experience in Phoenix.

Why a Birthday Limo?

  • Red carpet treatment for the birthday VIP
  • Group bonding on the way to celebrations
  • Photo opportunities inside luxury vehicles
  • Pre-party atmosphere with music and drinks
  • Door-to-door service no parking hassles

Bar crawl package

  • Sprinter or party bus
  • Old Town Scottsdale circuit

Vehicle Selection

For Intimate Groups (2-6)

Chrysler Limo (up to 8) or Luxury SUV (up to 6)

  • $150/hour or $125/hour, 4-hour minimum
  • BYOB toast for guests 21 and over (we do not sell alcohol)
  • Decorated for the occasion
  • Perfect for couples or small friend groups

For Party Groups (8-14)

Limo Party Sprinter (up to 13 or 16) or Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter (up to 15)

  • $175/hour or $250/hour, 4-hour minimum
  • Sound system for playlists
  • LED party lighting
  • Room to dance

For Large Celebrations (15-28)

Party Bus (28 Pax) or Pink Hummer Limo (up to 18)

  • $250/hour or $295/hour, 4-hour minimum
  • Bar area you stock yourself (BYOB, 21 and over)
  • Dance floor
  • Photo-worthy interior

Sample Birthday Itineraries

Bar Crawl Birthday (6 hours)

7:00 PM - Pickup (birthday decorations ready)
7:30 PM - Dinner at birthday guest's favorite spot
9:30 PM - First bar/club in Old Town
10:30 PM - Second venue
11:30 PM - Third venue (cake presentation)
1:00 AM - Return home

Day Adventure Birthday (8 hours)

10:00 AM - Pickup with brunch provisions
11:00 AM - Brunch at Hash Kitchen
1:00 PM - Shopping at Fashion Square
3:00 PM - Pool party at W Scottsdale
6:00 PM - Return to freshen up

Wine Country Birthday (7 hours)

10:00 AM - Depart Phoenix
12:00 PM - First winery (Page Springs)
2:00 PM - Lunch at Alcantara
4:00 PM - Final tasting (Javelina Leap)
5:30 PM - Return to Phoenix
